title: Round route tolerance readouts
summary: Round the visible Settings route height tolerance percentage controls and readouts to whole percents while preserving precise generated values for unchanged controls.
reason: Operators need the route tolerance percentages for scanning, not precision editing, so values like 11.111111% should display as 11%.
behavior_before: Route height tolerance controls and readouts displayed six-decimal percentages such as 11.111111%, 16.597222%, 24.930556%, and 16.666667%.
behavior_after: Route height tolerance controls and readouts display nearest whole percents such as 11%, 17%, 25%, and 17%; unchanged generated controls still collect precise settings values.
manual_validation: Browser-backed Settings route tolerance visible input check via the repository CDP harness -> passed; visible inputs and readouts rendered as 11/11%, 17/17%, 25/25%, and 17/17%, while collected payload values remained 11.111111, 16.597222, 24.930556, and 16.666667.
